Title: Identify AI Applications in Scope
Description: List all LLM-powered applications to instrument. Document: application name / cloud platform / app stack / LLM provider / database.

Title: Align on Success Criteria
Description: Define 3-5 success criteria. Recommended: SC1: Performance Monitoring / SC2: Evaluation & Quality / SC3: Development Lifecycle Tracking / SC4: Experiments & Comparison

Title: Confirm LLM Request Volume Estimates
Success Criteria: Volume estimates documented for BOQ scoping

Title: Execute POV — Instrumentation
Success Criteria: Full telemetry coverage across AI stack

Title: Install ddtrace for Python
Description: https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/setup/auto_instrumentation/?tab=python
Success Criteria: LLM spans visible in LLM Observability

Title: Install ddtrace for Node.js
Description: https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/setup/auto_instrumentation/?tab=nodejs
Success Criteria: LLM spans visible in LLM Observability

Title: (Alternative) OpenTelemetry for LLMObs
Description: https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/instrumentation/otel_instrumentation/

Title: OpenAI Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace. Captures: prompts / completions / tool calls / token usage / cost.

Title: Anthropic Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace.

Title: Google Gen AI SDK (Vertex AI / Gemini) Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace. Supports google.generativeai and vertexai SDKs.

Title: AWS Bedrock Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace.

Title: LangChain / LangGraph Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace.

Title: Amazon Strands Agent Integration
Description: Auto-instrumented via ddtrace.

Title: Annotate Workflows / Tasks / Agents
Description: Use @llmobs.workflow / @llmobs.task / @llmobs.agent decorators for custom span hierarchy.
Success Criteria: Custom span tree visible in traces

Title: Annotate LLM Spans
Description: Use LLMObs.annotate() to add metadata / tags / custom fields to spans.

Title: Correlate LLMObs with APM Traces
Description: Set DD_LLMOBS_AGENTLESS_ENABLED or configure trace correlation. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/setup/sdk/python/#correlate-llm-observability-traces-with-apm-traces
Success Criteria: LLMObs spans linked to APM traces

Title: MCP Clients Monitoring
Description: https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/monitoring/mcp_clients/
Success Criteria: MCP calls traced as tool spans

Title: Execute POV — SC1: Performance Monitoring
Success Criteria: How is my LLM/Agent performing? How can I monitor it?

Title: Validate LLM Tracing
Description: Verify traces in LLM Observability Traces page. Filter by ml_app. Confirm: request count / error rate / p95 latency / cost.
Success Criteria: All LLM calls traced with full metadata

Title: Token Usage & Cost Tracking
Description: Verify input tokens / output tokens / estimated cost per call. Aggregate by ml_app / env / model_name.
Success Criteria: Cost metrics visible per model and app

Title: Agentic Workflow Visibility
Description: For multi-step agents: verify full span tree showing workflow → task → llm_call → tool hierarchy.
Success Criteria: Complete span tree visible for agent workflows

Title: Create LLMObs Monitors
Description: Configure monitors for: error rate spikes / latency anomalies / cost outliers / token budget alerts.

Title: LLMObs Dashboard
Description: Build custom dashboard with key LLM metrics: requests / errors / latency / cost / tokens by ml_app and model.

Title: Execute POV — SC2: Evaluation & Quality
Success Criteria: How can I evaluate response quality and define custom scoring?

Title: OOTB Managed Evaluations
Description: Requires OpenAI / Anthropic / Bedrock API keys (BYOK). Includes: Hallucination Detection / Prompt Injection / Toxicity / Sensitive Data (PII) / Sentiment / Failure to Answer / Topic Relevance. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/evaluations/
Success Criteria: OOTB eval scores visible on traces

Title: Custom LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations
Description: Framework-agnostic. Define: judge prompt / output type (Boolean/Score/Categorical/JSON) / pass-fail thresholds. Supports: OpenAI / Anthropic / Bedrock / Vertex AI (Gemini) / Azure OpenAI / AI Gateway. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/evaluations/custom_llm_as_a_judge_evaluations
Success Criteria: Custom eval scores visible on traces

Title: RAGAS Integration (for RAG pipelines)
Description: Supported metrics: Faithfulness / Answer Relevancy / Context Precision. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/ragas_evaluations/

Title: Computational Evaluations
Description: Regex match / field extraction correctness / structured output validation. Submit via SDK: https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/submit_evaluations/

Title: Human Annotation & Ground Truth
Description: Annotate traces with human feedback in LLMObs UI. Save approved outputs to Dataset (Input + Expected Output + Metadata).
Success Criteria: Ground truth dataset created with 50+ samples

Title: Cluster Visualization for Drift Detection
Description: Use prompt-response cluster visualizations to identify quality drifts and isolate low-quality outputs.

Title: Execute POV — SC3: Development Lifecycle
Success Criteria: How do I track performance across code/prompt changes?

Title: Prompt Management & Versioning
Description: Track prompt templates as versioned artifacts with prompt_id. Per-version metrics: requests / latency / tokens / cost / eval scores. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/prompt_management/
Success Criteria: Prompt versions tracked with per-version metrics

Title: APM Deployment Version Correlation
Description: Set DD_VERSION to deployment tag. All spans (APM + LLMObs) tagged with version. Compare versions in APM. https://docs.datadoghq.eu/tracing/deployment_tracking/
Success Criteria: Deployment markers visible on LLMObs dashboards

Title: Quality Regression Monitors
Description: Configure monitors that alert when eval scores drop after deployment or prompt version change.
Success Criteria: Regression alert triggered on test scenario

Title: Execute POV — SC4: Experiments & Comparison
Success Criteria: How do I run systematic experiments to compare models/prompts?

Title: Build Dataset from Production Traces
Description: Save annotated production traces as versioned Dataset (Input + Expected Output + Metadata). https://docs.datadoghq.eu/llm_observability/experiments/

Title: Define Task Function
Description: Python function: input → LLM call → output → score. Attach evaluators.

Title: Run Experiment
Description: Configure: model / temperature / prompt version / system instructions. Run via LLMObs.run_experiment(). Parallel execution with error handling.

Title: Compare Results in UI
Description: Side-by-side: Run A vs Run B on eval_score / accuracy / latency_p95 / cost. Scatter plot: cost vs quality. Select winner.

Title: LLM Playground
Description: Quickly test prompt tweaks / swap models / fine-tune parameters before running full experiments.

Title: Confirm LLM Request Volume for Pricing
Description: LLMObs pricing: minimum 100K LLM requests at $80/month. Additional: $8 per 10K requests.

Title: Review Sensitive Data Scanner Inclusion
Description: SDS included with LLMObs for PII redaction in LLM traces.
